api_usage.scope_note: Entire recorded browser-verification ledger window, including the canceled server request and repeated preview calls. This is not an exclusive sum of displayed turns; concurrent CLI/legacy work would also appear. A preview tab closed before one repeated answer could be exported; its recorded calls remain in this window.

limitations: AI source review and verbatim witness checks do not establish human-verified accuracy or guarantee every paraphrase.
Local preflight recognizes patterns; an alternative fake booking phrasing was refused after retrieval/generation, not before Azure.
Saved PDF extraction can contain layout artifacts; the reader displays the stored extraction honestly.
Source pages are dated snapshots. Azure retention is governed by the resource terms; store=false is not a no-retention guarantee.
Abort stops browser waiting; the server continues and can spend.
Cost is estimated; generation ledger kind combines drafting and review, and concurrent processes can affect window attribution.
